name: チャット記録
oneline: 「ランチ 3万ドン」で支出、「明日 資料 締切」で締切を記録する
usage: 1行送ると記録され、確認の返事も1行で届く
支出は通貨（ドン・円）を見分ける。単位がないときは金額から推定し、返事に「通貨は推定」と出す
締切は Desk のタスクに期日付きで入る。「締切」と送ると「あと3日」の形で一覧が届く
「読書30分」のような習慣の文は07番へ渡す。07番が動くまでは預かる
Telegram がなくても chatlog.py で同じ記録ができる
howToCheck: マージのあと、ターミナルで Desk のフォルダを開く
python3 lifeos/12-chatlog/chatlog.py "ランチ 3万ドン" のように、今日の本当の支出を1つ打つ
返事が1行で、金額と通貨が合っていることを見る
データ置き場の logs/expenses.md に同じ行があることを見る
python3 lifeos/12-chatlog/chatlog.py "明日 資料 締切" のように、本当の締切を1つ打つ
返事に「あと1日」と出ることを見る
Desk のタスクに期日とカウントダウン付きで出ることを見る
Telegram がつながったら、同じ文をボットに送って同じ返事が来ることを見る

_en.name: Chat log
_en.oneline: "ランチ 3万ドン" (lunch 30k dong) logs spending, and "明日 資料 締切" (docs due tomorrow) logs a deadline
usage: Send one line and it is logged. A one-line confirmation comes back
Spending tells currencies apart (dong and yen). Without a unit, it guesses from the amount and the reply says the currency is a guess
Deadlines go into Desk tasks with a due date. Send "締切" (deadlines) to get a list like "3 days left"
Habit lines such as "読書30分" (reading 30 min) go to No. 07. Until No. 07 runs, they are held
Without Telegram, chatlog.py logs the same way
howToCheck: After the merge, open the Desk folder in Terminal
Type one real expense from today, like python3 lifeos/12-chatlog/chatlog.py "ランチ 3万ドン"
Check that the reply is one line and the amount and currency are right
Check that the same line is in logs/expenses.md in the data folder
Type one real deadline, like python3 lifeos/12-chatlog/chatlog.py "明日 資料 締切"
Check that the reply says 1 day left
Check that it shows in Desk tasks with a due date and countdown
Once Telegram is connected, send the same lines to the bot and check that the replies match

blockers.why: Which calendar to write to is not decided, and there is no permission to write. Deadlines go into tasks, and the calendar part waits in a queue.
blockers.needs: Choose one calendar for deadlines and tell the coordinator it is OK to write there in the hourly sync. Steps are in INTEGRATION.md
